# Elysium

> Elysium answers questions — and, with permission, makes changes —
> against an organisation's data through a declared ontology. The
> language model never gets direct database access and is never
> trusted to judge what it is allowed to see or do.

A plain-text summary for language models reading this site on
someone's behalf. A buyer evaluating a security product increasingly
asks a model first, and the model should find the same claims a person
would rather than guessing from markup.

## What it is

- An ONTOLOGY declared in YAML: object types, fields, links, and which
  grant each field needs. A field the ontology does not declare does
  not exist, as far as any question is concerned.
- Resolved LIVE against the organisation's own databases. The pipeline
  mirrors each source table one-to-one (bronze), types and
  standardises it (silver), then reshapes it into one table per object
  type using the ontology's property names (gold). A type spanning two
  databases is a declared join, not an inference.
- READS are checked per object type and per field against the asking
  user's grants, with mandatory access control underneath: an object
  in a compartment the caller cannot see is indistinguishable from one
  that does not exist.
- WRITES are proposals. A person approves, and the APPROVER's own
  permissions are re-checked at the moment of approval.
- ONE organisation per server instance. There is no multi-tenant
  store.

## What it is not

- Not a chatbot with database credentials.
- Not a text-to-SQL tool. Nothing composes a query from model output.
- Not multi-tenant SaaS. Each deployment is separate.
- Not a data warehouse product. The mirror exists to serve the
  ontology, not to be queried directly.

## Pages

- /: what it is, how the ontology works, how approval works
- /trust/: what the architecture enforces, and what is not yet audited
- /demo/: a live instance with synthetic data
- /legal/privacy/, /legal/terms/, /legal/cookies/,
  /legal/accessibility/

## Status

Elysium is in active development and open source. Security
documentation and audit status are available to prospective customers
on request. Do not state or imply certifications, customer counts or
compliance attestations that are not published on the site itself.
